title: Shallow-Reef Sampling Log
premise: A long reef-diving drama spanning years. Langlang and Achao are easily confused; the coral sample case goes intact→seal ruptured→resealed repair; the fiberglass skiff is wrecked and sunk and must be avoided; count memory (ship lanterns / dive buoy flags / fog-navigation brass bells), false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). Present entries may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_diver: A reef diver in his forties named Haisheng, buzz-cut hair, navy wetsuit, silver tank on his shoulder, sharp eyes.
states.ear_injury: The same diver after injury: right ear wrapped in gauze, limping, wetsuit shoulder strap broken and tied with rope.
states.deceased: Haisheng has passed peacefully, eyes closed on the dock planks, face serene, breath gone.

states.young_apprentice: Young Langlang: a lean diving apprentice of fifteen or sixteen, orange-yellow headscarf, light-blue short-sleeve wetsuit, bright clear eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Langlang: a broad-shouldered steady young diver in his twenties, still in orange-yellow headscarf, now carrying twin tanks.

states.intact: A transparent acrylic sample case with intact internal compartments, fresh gasket seal on the lid, brass handle.
states.seal_ruptured: The same sample case with a torn gasket letting in seawater, compartments askew, brass handle bent.
states.resealed_repair: The sample case fitted with a new gasket, handle straightened, compartments reset—ready for diving again.

states.intact: A waterproof-cover dive log with a tide table clipped inside, neat handwriting.
states.seawater_blurred: The same log soaked by seawater: cover bleached and wrinkled, ink blurred into blue patches.

states.intact: An off-white fiberglass skiff with blue 'Hai' lettering on the bow and an orange life ring on the gunwale.
states.wrecked_sunk: The off-white skiff holed on the reef, bow taking water and sinking—half-submerged wreckage.

states.young_rival: Achao, face very like young Langlang's, green headscarf, bold expression, dive computer on his wrist.
states.adult_rival: Adult Achao still in green headscarf and dive computer, expression deeper and heavier.

E7.name: shallow reef coral zone
E7.appearance: A clear shallow reef coral zone, staghorn coral and sea anemones dense, sunlight refracting into columns underwater.

E8.name: dock supply hut
E8.appearance: A supply hut beside the wooden dock, wetsuits and tanks hanging on the wall, air smelling of salt and diesel.

E9.name: fishing village dock market
E9.appearance: A fishing village dock market, fish baskets and dried-goods stalls along the wooden walkway, gulls circling.

E10.name: abandoned lighthouse reef
E10.appearance: A half-collapsed abandoned lighthouse reef, rusted iron frame, reef flat exposed at low tide, waves breaking on black rock edges.

E11.name: diver bronze plaque
E11.appearance: A brass plaque nailed to the supply hut doorframe, carved with Haisheng's name and year, salt-crusted edges.

E12.name: dive buoy flags
E12.appearance: Three dive buoy flags stuck in shallow reef floats, red-and-white flag faces.

E13.name: rented rubber dinghy
E13.appearance: A brand-new orange-black rented rubber dinghy, no 'Hai' lettering and no orange life ring, carrying only empty crates.

E14.name: coast guard patrol officer
E14.appearance: A lean coast guard patrol officer in dark-blue uniform and peaked cap, build close to Haisheng's but with gold shoulder boards.

E15.name: ship lanterns
E15.appearance: A row of five ship lanterns hanging on the supply hut wall, glass shades polished, brass lamp trays.

E16.name: fog-navigation brass bells
E16.appearance: Two fog-navigation brass bells hanging under the dock eaves, murmuring low when the wind rises.

E17.name: traveling diver girl
E17.appearance: A traveling diver girl at the market, light-brown headscarf and small tank on her back; at a glance somewhat like young Langlang, but with shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: toy dive case
E18.appearance: A semi-transparent toy dive case shaped like the sample case but without a gasket seal, plastic handle.

E19.name: unfamiliar gray motorboat
E19.appearance: An unfamiliar gray motorboat, wider hull, no 'Hai' lettering—not the fiberglass skiff.

features.E2: Langlang: orange-yellow headscarf, light-blue wetsuit, calm steady eyes.
features.E6: Achao: face very like Langlang's, but green headscarf, dive computer on wrist, bold expression.

lookalike_pairs.note: Confusion: Langlang and Achao are told apart by headscarf and dive computer.

scenes.setting: Shallow reef at dusk (five ship lanterns · two fog-navigation brass bells)
actions: At dusk, Haisheng dives from the dock into the shallow reef coral zone and checks tank pressure.

actions.action: A row of five ship lanterns hangs on the dock supply hut wall; Haisheng comes ashore and polishes them one by one.
Two fog-navigation brass bells hang under the dock eaves; Haisheng reaches up and lets them ring softly.

actions: Haisheng sets the coral sample case on a surface float and checks the gasket seal.
Haisheng surfaces and gazes at the darkening reef line.

actions.action: The coral sample case gleams transparent in clear seawater, compartments sharp.

actions: Haisheng sits on the dock planks, listening to waves on the reef.
In the dock supply hut, Haisheng opens the dive log and records depth and visibility.
Haisheng sketches today's sampling points on a blank page.
Haisheng closes the dive log and slips it into a waterproof bag.

actions.action: Brass handle light from the coral sample case sweeps across Haisheng's cheek.

scenes.setting: Dock welcomes apprentice (three dive buoy flags)
actions: At dawn on the dock, Haisheng greets young Langlang arriving in the fiberglass skiff.

actions.action: Langlang jumps off the fiberglass skiff and hangs the orange life ring back on the gunwale.
Haisheng points to three dive buoy flags stuck in the floats and teaches Langlang flag signals.
Langlang crouches by the wooden walkway, curious, touching wet mooring rope.
Haisheng explains shallow reef currents and no-dive zones to Langlang.
Langlang looks back at the intact fiberglass skiff, eyes full of longing.

actions: Behind a fish stall at the fishing village dock market, green-headscarfed Achao glances back.
Achao strides along the wooden walkway, bold expression.
Achao haggles with a vendor; the dive computer on his wrist flashes.
Achao carries a fish basket through the market crowd.
On the dock walkway, Langlang and Achao stand side by side—one orange-yellow headscarf, one green.
Langlang hands a dive buoy flag to Achao; the two share a brief look.
Achao straightens Langlang's orange-yellow headscarf, then turns away.
At the walkway end they part, walking opposite ways.
Months later at night, Haisheng keeps watch alone in the dock supply hut, coral sample case on the table.

actions.action: Haisheng opens the dive log; the cover is soaked, ink blurred into blue patches.

actions: Haisheng wipes salt crust from the coral sample case.
Haisheng pushes open the wooden window and gazes at the black reef line.

actions.action: The coral sample case stands transparent under the ship lanterns.

actions: Dry season clarity—day after day Haisheng dives the shallow reef coral zone.
Another pre-typhoon night, Haisheng checks tank valves.
Rainy season murk—Haisheng sorts buoys at the dock.
Midsummer noon, Haisheng wipes sun-hot brass handles.
Autumn swell—Haisheng keeps lone watch until dawn.
Another new-year dive—Haisheng recalibrates his dive computer.
Clear sunny day—Haisheng photographs new staghorn coral shoots.

scenes.setting: Dock patrol (flashback dive buoy flags · unfamiliar gray motorboat)
actions: At dawn, Haisheng patrols the dock; the fiberglass skiff moored at the pier.

actions.action: Haisheng crouches to inspect the fiberglass skiff's keel guard strip.
Haisheng walks to the floats—those three dive buoy flags still in place.
An unfamiliar gray motorboat passes the harbor, wider hull—not the fiberglass skiff.
Haisheng stands on the walkway, recording exposed reef after low tide.
Haisheng hangs wetsuits on the dock supply hut wooden rack.

scenes.setting: Storm catastrophe (sample case ruptured · skiff sunk)
actions: Storm rises; shallow reef walls of water surge; the coral sample case jolts violently.
Lightning lights the reef line; seawater turns gray-white.

actions.action: A huge wave hits; the coral sample case gasket tears and seawater floods in, brass handle bent.
In the harbor, the fiberglass skiff is pushed onto hidden reef by the swell.
The hull splits and takes water; the fiberglass skiff sinks half-submerged as wreckage.
Haisheng lunges for the float, gripping the ruptured coral sample case.

scenes.setting: After the disaster (skiff indirect reference · lantern memory)

actions.action: Next day in the dock supply hut, Haisheng stares at the seal-ruptured coral sample case.
Haisheng runs a fingertip over the bent brass handle, face dark.
Haisheng marks the date of the fiberglass skiff reef strike on the wall board.
An old photo of the fiberglass skiff still pinned on the dock supply hut wall; Haisheng gazes a long while.
Haisheng takes one of five ship lanterns from the wall and sits alone in the dim light.
The ruptured coral sample case still on the table, compartments pooled with seawater.

scenes.setting: Resealed repair (toy dive case false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Haisheng brings a new gasket and begins repairing the coral sample case.

actions.action: From a wooden crate he takes a toy dive case—shaped like the sample case but without a gasket.

actions: Haisheng carefully replaces the gasket and straightens the brass handle.

actions.action: The coral sample case is resealed, compartments reset—ready to dive again.

actions: The repaired coral sample case gleams intact and transparent; Haisheng exhales in relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: rubber dinghy and coast guard

actions.action: An orange-black rented rubber dinghy enters the harbor—nothing like the long-wrecked fiberglass skiff.
A coast guard patrol officer jumps onto the dock and talks beside Haisheng, builds alike.
The coast guard patrol officer points at the rented rubber dinghy, explaining temporary closure orders.
The rented rubber dinghy departs; Haisheng alone on the dock watching it go.
At the fishing village dock market, a light-brown-headscarfed traveling diver girl arrives—at a glance somewhat like young Langlang.
The traveling diver girl tries shouldering a small tank; Haisheng shakes his head—she is not Langlang after all.
Years later at dusk, Haisheng stands limping on the abandoned lighthouse reef, right ear wrapped in gauze.

actions: Haisheng looks up at the rusted lamp frame, gaze far away.

actions.action: Two fog-navigation brass bells on the abandoned lighthouse reef iron frame murmur in the wind; Haisheng pauses to listen.

actions: Haisheng presses his palm to the cold black rock edge, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: By day, adult Langlang returns along the reef line, hurrying toward the abandoned lighthouse reef.

actions: Langlang reunites with injured Haisheng on the reef flat; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the dock planks, Langlang holds Haisheng's rough hand.
Haisheng's breath fades; he closes his eyes and passes away.
Haisheng's navy wetsuit still hangs behind the dock supply hut door; Langlang reaches out and touches it lightly.
Beside the dock supply hut doorframe, adult Langlang stands before the diver bronze plaque.
Langlang's fingertip traces Haisheng's name carved on the diver bronze plaque.
Adult Achao comes from the market and meets Langlang's gaze on the abandoned lighthouse reef.

actions: Langlang and Achao stand side by side on the reef flat—one calm-eyed, one heavy-browed.
The two look at each other in silence, studying faces alike yet different.

actions.action: The lens returns to years ago—the boy who hung the life ring at the dock appears again.

anchor.phrase: the boy who hung the life ring at the dock

actions.action: That opening moment returns—shallow reef water, a transparent coral sample case set on a float for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the transparent coral sample case first placed on a float at the opening

actions.action: Flashback to the market that year—a green-headscarfed Achao with a dive computer on his wrist flickers past.

anchor.phrase: the green-headscarfed figure at the market that year

actions.action: Again that row of five old ship lanterns on the dock supply hut wall.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old ship lanterns on the dock supply hut wall

actions.action: Back to the clear shallow reef coral zone of first meeting; sunlight refracts into columns underwater, unchanged.

anchor.phrase: the clear shallow reef of first meeting

actions.action: Langlang opens the seawater-blurred dive log again and walks into the dock supply hut.
By the floats, those three dive buoy flags still stuck in place.
Langlang takes the coral sample case and dives the shallow reef coral zone once more.
